component.name: Roblox (memory, Proton)
component.summary: Run Roblox + the memory executor on Linux via a patched Proton

description.p: Bundles a Proton build whose kernelbase.dll exports SetProcessValidCallTargets as a no-op so Roblox's Byfron/Hyperion loader runs under Wine. Installs WebView2 into the prefix for the in-app browser, registers roblox:// and roblox-player:// URI handlers to the sandbox, and tunes DXVK for stability.

memory.exe is not bundled — on first launch the app asks you to pick it from disk. The DLL swap runs once; after that web login + Play launches straight into the game with the executor overlay active.
